g.text: FRANK LLOYD WRIGHT (1950) · T. HEINZ AIA
MASSARO HOUSE & 1951 FLW CHAHROUDI GUEST COTTAGE
PETRA ISLAND · LAKE MAHOPAC, NEW YORK · CONTRACTOR BIM & CONSTRUCTION DRAWING SET (ISO 19650 / IFC4)
CALIBRATED SITE EXTENTS: 134.55m × 129.75m (441'-5" × 425'-8") · 903 IFC4 MODEL ELEMENTS (REV P03.1 AS-BUILT EXTERIOR REDLINE SET) · 18 CAMERA / WAYPOINT STATIONS
Cover Sheet, ISO 19650 Register, Legends & General Contractor Notes
Master Site Plan — Petra Island, Lake Mahopac, Dock & Both Residences
Main Residence Floor Plan — Cantilever Living (+3.20m) & Split-Level (+3.80m)
Main Residence Roof, 27-Skylight Grid, Helipad & Copper Fascia Plan
Main Residence Reflected Ceiling Plan (RCP), Skylights & LED Cove Lighting
1951 FLW Chahroudi Guest Cottage — Floor Plan, Hex Rafters & Elevations
Main Residence Exterior Elevations — West (Lake), South, East & North
Building Sections A–A (Cantilever Girder & Atrium) & B–B (Whale Rock & Kitchen)
Enlarged Interior Elevations — Whale Rock Kitchen, Crane Mural, Master & Bath
BIM Quantity Take-Off (QTO), IFC4 Entity Schedule, CSI Trades & Room Schedule
• Interactive Contractor BIM Viewer: bim.html (IFC4 class tree, CSI trade filters,
6-plane section box, laser measurement tool, CSV BOQ & IFC4 STEP export).
• Native Precambrian granite outcrops ('Whale Rock', 'Tail Rock', Bath & Study
boulders) shall remain undisturbed in-situ. Concrete slabs, waterproof
sealants, and honed bluestone countertops shall be scribed directly to rock.
• SW Living Wing cantilevers 8.53m (28'-0") beyond shoreline pier over Lake
Mahopac via 3 tapered concrete girders anchored to bedrock counterweights.
• All interior/exterior wood frames, soffits, banquettes & casework: FAS-grade
kiln-dried African Mahogany. Roof fascia: 20-oz patinaed standing-seam copper.
• Atrium roof grid: 27 equilateral triangular insulated low-E glass pyramids.
• Historic 1951 Frank Lloyd Wright cottage (BLDG-02, EL +5.16m): preserve
battered desert-rubble masonry, hexagonal exposed rafters & stained glass.
PROJECT BUILDING & STOREY FEDERATION MATRIX (IFC4 SPATIAL HIERARCHY)
5,000 SQ FT (465 m²) · 2 LEVELS + ROOF HELIPAD
• L00 Substructure (EL +0.20m to +2.82m): 5 Desert-Rubble Piers + 3 Post-Tensioned Cantilever Girders
• L01 Lower Cantilever Wing (EL +3.20m): Great Living Room, SW Prow Balcony, South Lake Terrace
• L02 Upper Split-Level Wing (EL +3.80m): Whale Rock Entry, 27-Skylight Atrium, Crane Mural Gallery,
Whale-Rock Kitchen, Boat-Table Dining Room, East Master Suite, Rock-Shower Bath & North Prow Study
• L04 Roof & Helipad (EL +7.48m to +10.12m): 27 Triangular Skylights, Ø9.3m Helipad, US Flag, Copper Fascia
1,200 SQ FT (111 m²) · HISTORIC GUEST HOUSE (EL +5.16m)
• Authentic 1951 Frank Lloyd Wright structure upslope in the northeastern island clearing
• Battered Desert-Rubble NW Kitchen Wing (Hexagonal Stained-Glass Window & Vintage Red Stove)
• Monumental Battered Concrete Fireplace Hood with Cast-In Gold/Tan Granite Boulder Slab & Mesh Screen
• Exposed Hexagonal Timber Rafter Ceiling (30+ Radiating Rafters), Folding Doors & Bedroom Alcove
• 4 Mahogany French Doors onto 3-Step Cherokee-Red Terrace & Triangular Lakeside Reflection Pool
• Western Cove Timber Pile Pier (EL +0.62m), Cantilevered Boathouse Canopy & Moored Runabout Boat
• Terracotta Seawall Apron, 8-Step Arrival Promenade & Sloped Bluestone Island Walkway
• NE Pyramid-Hipped Utility Shed, Woodland Shed, Boat Trailer & 120-Tree Deciduous Woodland Canopy
REV P03.1 AS-BUILT EXTERIOR REDLINE SUMMARY (RL-01 TO RL-08)
▲ REDLINE REGISTER · REV P03.1 AS-BUILT FIELD VERIFICATION
RL-01 (A-100/A-201): Removed unauthentic white boathouse canopy; added NW Rubblestone Bastion & Steep Cherokee-Red Boat Gangway.
RL-02 (A-101/A-201/A-301): Deleted SW Prow glass railing; added Mitered Battered Buff-Stucco Cantilever Parapet (EL +2.86m..+4.75m).
RL-03 (A-101/A-201): Added Hexagonal Desert-Rubblestone Lake Support Pier, Full-Height Mid-NW Stone Wall & 14-Bay Mahogany Ribbon Windows.
RL-04 (A-102/A-301): Added Mitered Battered Standing-Seam Copper Roof Fascia (0.58m O.C. seams), Dark Olive Roof Deck & 4 Stone Chimneys.
RL-05 (A-104): Added Cherokee-Red Eave Fascia, Weathered Grey Shingles & Flush 5-Sided Fieldstone Slabs on 1951 Chahroudi Cottage.
